lessons_used: Helpful changes: Adoption visual style and photo quality enhancements (custom selectors, pre-upload inspection, spotlight stage redesign, photo quality callouts), split-view path layouts, preset fast-track flows, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, background readiness hints, and wait-time progress tip carousels.

Worse performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners, pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts and flexibility copy, and interactive sound/visual wait progress led to significant losses.

No clear effect: Notifications, account sync/persistence flows and subsequent sign-in reorderings, diagnostic/archetype flows, waiting overlays/time indicators, visibility prompts, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions were too low: Photo quality callouts, interactive progress tip carousels, split-view path selection screens, custom pet style selectors, background readiness hints, and pre-upload style inspection views.
Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, post-adoption sign-in reordering, split-view story intros, and all tests that resulted in no clear effect or negative performance.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Companion Launch Welcome Layout
candidates.change: Replaces the home_intro welcome layout with an immersive full-bleed presentation showing the companion ready on the desktop workspace.
candidates.why: The finish step suffers from a sharp drop-off (64.8% completion, mean 5815s); a full-bleed visual layout creates an impactful arrival moment.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Your new desktop companion is fully set up and ready to join your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home_intro layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off, but finish redesigns consistently degraded conversion (-7.2% measured).

candidates.title: Interactive Story Scroll Intro Stage
candidates.change: Adds a story scroll intro screen before path selection featuring interactive previews of companion behaviors.
candidates.why: 16.5% of users abandon at path selection; an engaging story scroll introduces app value upfront.

new_story_scroll_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop World
new_story_scroll_intro.body: Explore companion possibilities before choosing how you want to bring yours to life.

candidates.title: Compact Photo Selection Grid Layout
candidates.change: Redesigns the photo upload screen into a compact grid layout with immediate preview components.
candidates.why: Adoption step has high median duration (89s); a compact layout speeds up photo upload choices.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen into a compact grid layout retains its core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has low drop-off, but adoption visual/layout enhancements consistently perform well (+4.3%).

candidates.title: Desktop Activation Action Spotlight View
candidates.change: Introduces a spotlight component focus on the final welcome screen highlighting the exact desktop spawn button.
candidates.why: Support mail indicates user confusion around opening or placing the pet on desktop after setup (3 emails) and low finish rate (64.8%).

home_intro.headline: Launch Your Pet Onto Desktop
home_intro.body: Click the button below to bring your companion directly onto your screen background.

guard.reason: Updating home_intro with a spotlight view and button label is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step supported directly by 3 support emails; spotlight focus visuals have strong historical precedent.

candidates.title: Desktop Environment Setup Progress Checklist
candidates.change: Adds a real-time environment checklist to the waiting screen displaying key background rendering milestones.
candidates.why: Home waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s; structured setup milestones keep users informed while waiting.

guard.reason: Adding a setup progress checklist component to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time, but waiting overlays and time indicators previously showed minimal effect (+0.9%).

candidates.title: Compact Split Authentication View
candidates.change: Reconfigures the sign_in screen to use a split layout separating quick guest continuation from cloud account login.
candidates.why: 21.7% of users drop off at sign_in; clear split options reduce hesitation.

sign_in.headline: Connect Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet saved safely in the cloud across app sessions.

guard.reason: Reconfiguring the sign_in screen to a split layout preserves authentication functionality.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in loses 21.7% of users; split-view layout adjustments generally yield mild positive results.

candidates.title: Minimalist Path Selection Headline Copy
candidates.change: Simplifies the headline and body text on the path selection screen to communicate quick setup speed.
candidates.why: 16.5% drop-off at choose_path; concise messaging lowers friction.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Adoption Path
choose_path.body: Choose preset fast-track or build a custom pet in just a few quick steps.

guard.reason: Updating headline and body copy on choose_path preserves both adoption paths without mentioning pricing.

candidates.score_note: Easy copy tweak, but choose_path copy changes previously resulted in negative performance (-2.8%).

candidates.change: Adds a clear framing guidance text hint component on the photo upload view.
candidates.why: 3 support emails report custom pet generation failures or distorted results due to bad source photos.

candidates.change: Enables an optional audio cue toggle component on the waiting screen when background generation completes.
candidates.why: Mean wait time is 2336s; sound cues notify users multi-tasking away from the app when setup finishes.

candidates.title: Account Session Reset Safeguard Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit hint copy on the sign_in screen explaining that logging into an existing account recovers existing pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after re-authenticating.

sign_in.hint: Signing into an existing account restores your existing desktop companions automatically.

guard.reason: Adding account restoration hint copy to the sign_in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails, but sign_in hints historically performed poorly (-2.6%).

lessons_next: Helpful changes: Adoption visual style and photo quality enhancements (custom selectors, pre-upload inspection, compact grid, stage redesign, photo callouts), split-view path layouts, preset fast-track adoption, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, session safeguard hints, and wait-time progress checklists/tip carousels consistently won.

Worse performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners/flows, pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path flexibility/minimalist copy, and interactive sound/visual wait progress caused significant losses.

No clear effect: Notifications, standard account sync/persistence flows, subsequent sign-in reorderings, desktop waiting overlays/time indicators, companion archetype flows, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions were too low: Photo quality callouts, pre-upload style inspections, custom pet style selectors, split-view path screens, readiness/safeguard hints, and wait-progress tip carousels/checklists performed better than predicted.

Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, initial post-adoption sign-in reordering, split-view story intros, and all tests that resulted in no clear effect or negative performance were overpredicted.
